name: Kerala Kalamandalam
summary: Kerala Kalamandalam is a deemed university for art and culture at Cheruthuruthy, on the Bharatapuzha river in Thrissur district, established in 1930 by the poet Vallathol Narayana Menon. It teaches Kathakali, Kutiyattam, Mohiniyattam, Thullal and percussion, and welcomes visitors for guided tours and programmes.
highlights: Founded in 1930 by the poet Vallathol Narayana Menon
Deemed to be University for Art & Culture, recognised by the UGC
Its Koothambalam is the first temple-style theatre built outside a temple complex, per Kerala Tourism
Guided tours, the Vallathol Museum, an art gallery and booked performances
Classes in Kathakali, Kutiyattam, Mohiniyattam, Thullal and percussion
